lines.text: Coming out of stealth. Avert your eyes.
Passing you. You're the legacy system.
That was a ten-x pass. I'll send the deck.
Closing the round. You're not in it.
Acquired by a bus. Congrats on the exit.
Again? You're going on the risks slide.
lines.audioNote: Redone 2026-10-02 (run W-S): both Whisper checks misheard the old take ("Again, you're going on the wrist slide."). Now Kokoro-82M, run locally, in Pivot's reference voice (am_adam, speed 1.1, pitch +1). Spoken as "Again? You're going on the risks... slide.". Veto it, or ask for the old take back from git history.

lines.text: Near miss. That's a podcast episode.
We're an AI company now. Since breakfast.
My AI agent scheduled this pass.
Disrupted. That's you, by the way.
We call that a learning. Bye.
We're excited to announce our next chapter.
lines.audioNote: Pivot FM's line after its dead air (run W-U): the radio asks for it (src/audio/rider-station.ts), not the bark director, so its trigger is interlude, which no race event fires. Voiced free with Kokoro-82M on the dev machine's GPU in Pivot's reference voice (redo_local.py take 0); both Whisper checks heard every word, voice z-score -1.34.

meta.notes: San Francisco local (playtest 1c). pivot-hit-ditch is his signature line, in the shape of the other rivals' approved lines; it is an agent draft until the maintainer approves or vetoes it, like every other line here. Startup vocabulary (stealth, ten-x, the deck, rounds, exits, burn rate) keeps him apart from Kevin's office-speak. W-Q (2026-10-02) added two heckles (trigger knocked-down-target: said riding past a rider who is down), text only until the next voice batch. Run W-U adds pivot-fm-next-chapter, the line Pivot FM (stations/sf-pivot-fm.json) says after its dead air when he is knocked down.

voice.model: ResembleAI/chatterbox (MIT), via fal on Hugging Face Inference Providers
voice.reference: hexgrad/Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0) voice am_adam, speed 1.1, pitch +1 semitones; synthetic, no real person's voice

review.method: Every clip transcribed on the dev machine's GPU by Whisper large-v3-turbo and large-v3, plus pitch, pace, level and a speaker-similarity check (WavLM) against the rival's other clips (tools/voices/scripts/check_local.py). Garbled (both checks heard other words) or off-voice clips were redone free with Kokoro-82M on the GPU in the rival's reference voice (tools/voices/scripts/redo_local.py); everything else was kept.
